title: LG CNS sets sights on APAC as it scales up AIDC development
content: LG CNS revealed its plan to expand AIDC development across Asia-Pacific as it completed a 30MW AI data center in Jakarta.

title: Marvell buys Lumentum in $115B AI networking power play
content: Marvell is acquiring Lumentum in an all-stock deal that bets AI’s next leap runs on optical networking, targeting a $550 billion market.

title: MRVL: M&A announcement
content: The combination targets integrated AI connectivity, pairing electrical design with Lumentum’s photonics and manufacturing capabilities. Management projects a $550 billion 2030 TAM, over $1 billion in run-rate cost synergies, and non-GAAP EPS accretion starting in year one post-close.
